symbols.name: sha256
symbols.content: def sha256(data):     return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

symbols.name: _decode_proof
symbols.content: def _decode_proof(token):     try:         prefix, body = token.split(".", 1)[0], token.split(".")[1]         if prefix != "sp1":             return None         return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(body + "=" * (-len(body) % 4)))     except (ValueError, IndexError, binascii.Error, json.JSONDecodeError):         return None

symbols.name: _collapse
symbols.content: def _collapse(text):     return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

symbols.name: verify_bundle
symbols.content: def verify_bundle(output_dir, render=None):     """Return a list of problems found in a standalone output directory.     Only local files are read. ``render`` optionally re-renders report.md from the     machine bundle (the packaged ``render_markdown_report``) for an exact comparison.     """     out = Path(output_dir)     problems = []     def bad(code, message):         problems.append(f"{code}: {message}")     try:         bundle = json.loads((out / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:         return [f"E_BUNDLE: bundle.json unreadable ({error})"]     if bundle.get("schema_version") != BUNDLE_SCHEMA:         bad("E_BUNDLE", f"schema_version {bundle.get('schema_version')!r}")     operation = bundle.get("operation_id")     outcomes = bundle.get("outcomes")     if not isinstance(operation, str) or not isinstance(outcomes, list) or not outcomes:         return problems + ["E_BUNDLE: missing operation_id or outcomes"]     try:         lines = [json.loads(line) for line in (out / "outcomes.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:         lines = None         bad("E_JSONL", f"outcomes.jsonl unreadable ({error})")     expected_lines = [         {"schema_version": bundle.get("schema_version"), "operation_id": operation, "outcome": o}         for o in outcomes     ]     if lines is not None and lines != expected_lines:         bad("E_JSONL", "outcomes.jsonl does not equal the bundle outcomes")     try:         report = (out / "report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")     except OSError as error:         report = ""         bad("E_REPORT", f"report.md unreadable ({error})")     if f"`{operation}`" not in report:         bad("E_REPORT", "report.md does not carry the bundle operation id")     if render is not None and report != render(bundle):         bad("E_REPORT", "report.md differs from a fresh render of bundle.json")     keys = [o.get("key") for o in outcomes]     if len(set(keys)) != len(keys):         bad("E_LINEAGE", "duplicate outcome keys")     store = out / "source-artifacts"     for index, outcome in enumerate(outcomes):         where = f"outcomes[{index}] ({outcome.get('key')})"         occurrence = f"input-{index}"         status = outcome.get("status")         if status not in TERMINAL:             bad("E_OUTCOME", f"{where}: status {status!r}")             continue         if f"## {outcome.get('key')} — {status}" not in report:             bad("E_REPORT", f"{where}: no report section for this outcome")         if outcome.get("disposition") != "unreviewed":             bad("E_OUTCOME", f"{where}: disposition must stay unreviewed")         observed = (outcome.get("links") or []) + (outcome.get("candidates") or []) + (outcome.get("observations") or [])         if status != "success":             # An error is never an empty success: it keeps a diagnostic and no content.             if not (outcome.get("diagnostic") or {}).get("code"):                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} without a diagnostic code")             if outcome.get("text") or observed:                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} carries extracted content")             if outcome.get("source_reference") is not None:                 bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: {status} carries an unvalidated source reference")             continue         if outcome.get("diagnostic") is not None:             bad("E_ERROR_EMPTY", f"{where}: success carries a diagnostic")         reference = outcome.get("source_reference")         if not reference or not reference.get("source_proof") or not reference.get("artifact"):             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: success without source proof")             continue         artifact = reference["artifact"]         digest = artifact.get("content_digest", "")         snapshot = artifact.get("snapshot_id", "")         # Both become path components; reject anything that is not a plain hex id.         if not (isinstance(digest, str) and SHA256_HEX.fullmatch(digest)                 and isinstance(snapshot, str) and HEX_ID.fullmatch(snapshot)):             bad("E_SOURCE_DIGEST", f"{where}: malformed content_digest/snapshot_id")             continue         body_path = store / "objects" / digest[:2] / f"{digest}.body"         try:             body = body_path.read_bytes()         except OSError:             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: retained body {body_path.relative_to(out)} is missing")             continue         if sha256(body) != digest or len(body) != artifact.get("byte_length"):             bad("E_SOURCE_DIGEST", f"{where}: retained body does not match its digest/length")             continue         proof = _decode_proof(reference["source_proof"])         if proof is None:             bad("E_SOURCE_PROOF_MISSING", f"{where}: source proof cannot be symbols.name: check_expectations
symbols.content: def check_expectations(output_dir, manifest, base_url):     """Compare the batch bundle with the fixture corpus' retained bytes and labels."""     bundle = json.loads((Path(output_dir) / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     sources = {s["id"]: s for s in manifest["sources"]}     problems = []     outcomes = {o["key"]: o for o in bundle["outcomes"]}     if list(outcomes) != list(BATCH):         problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: keys {list(outcomes)} != submitted {list(BATCH)}")     for key, (source_id, status, code) in BATCH.items():         outcome = outcomes.get(key)         if outcome is None:             continue         source = sources[source_id]         if outcome["requested_url"] != base_url + source["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} requested {outcome['requested_url']}")         if outcome["status"] != status or (outcome["diagnostic"] or {}).get("code") != code:             problems.append(f"E_OUTCOME: {key} is {outcome['status']}/{outcome['diagnostic']}, expected {status}/{code}")         if status != "success" or outcome["source_reference"] is None:             continue         final = sources[source["response"]["location"].strip("/")] if "location" in source["response"] else source         artifact = outcome["source_reference"]["artifact"]         if artifact["content_digest"] != final["sha256"]:             problems.append(f"E_SOURCE_DIGEST: {key} retained bytes differ from fixture {final['id']}")         if artifact["final_url"] != base_url + final["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} final_url {artifact['final_url']}")     empty, failure = outcomes.get("empty"), outcomes.get("failure")     if empty and (empty["text"] or empty["diagnostic"] is not None or empty["source_reference"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: legitimate empty page is not an empty success with source proof")     if failure and (failure["source_reference"] is not None or failure["diagnostic"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: HTTP failure is not an explicit error")     first, again = outcomes.get("static"), outcomes.get("static-again")     if first and again and first["source_reference"] and again["source_reference"]:         if first["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"] == again["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"]:             problems.append("E_LINEAGE: duplicate URL occurrences share one snapshot")     return problems

symbols.name: _load_fixtures
symbols.content: def _load_fixtures():     spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("acquisition_fixtures", REPO / "scripts/acquisition_fixtures.py")     module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)     spec.loader.exec_module(module)     return module

symbols.name: _sh
symbols.content: def _sh(command, **kwargs):     proc = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, **kwargs)     if proc.returncode != 0:         raise RuntimeError(f"{' '.join(map(str, command))} failed ({proc.returncode}): {proc.stderr[-2000:]}")     return proc.stdout

symbols.name: build_and_install
symbols.content: def build_and_install(run, revision):     """Package the committed tree (not the working tree) and install it in a fresh venv."""     source = run.work / "source"     wheels = run.work / "wheels"     venv = run.work / "venv"     wheels.mkdir(parents=True)     source.mkdir()     tree = _sh(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", f"{revision}^{{tree}}"]).strip()     archive = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "archive", "--format=tar", revision],                              capture_output=True, check=True).stdout     subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(source)], input=archive, check=True)     started = time.monotonic()     for package in PACKAGES:         _sh(["uv", "build", "--wheel", "-q", "-o", str(wheels), str(next(source.glob(f"*-{package}")))])     requirements = run.work / "requirements.txt"     enrichers = next(source.glob("*-enrichers")).name     _sh(["uv", "export", "--frozen", "--no-hashes", "--no-emit-workspace", "--no-dev",          "--package", enrichers, "-q", "-o", str(requirements)], cwd=source)     _sh(["uv", "venv", "-q", "--python", sys.executable if sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12) else "3.12", str(venv)])     _sh(["uv", "pip", "install", "-q", "--python", str(venv / "bin/python"), "--find-links", str(wheels),          "-r", str(requirements), *map(str, sorted(wheels.glob("*.whl")))])     entry = next((venv / "bin").glob("*-standalone-scraper"))     run.measurements["build_install_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)     return {         "revision": _sh(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", revision]).strip(),         "source_tree": tree,         "wheels": {w.name: sha256(w.read_bytes()) for w in sorted(wheels.glob("*.whl"))},         "lock_export_sha256": sha256(requirements.read_bytes()),         "uv_lock_sha256": sha256((source / "uv.lock").read_bytes()),         "entrypoint": entry.name,         "python": _sh([str(venv / "bin/python"), "--version"]).strip(),     }, venv, entry

symbols.name: _render_with
symbols.content: def _render_with(python):     """Return a callable rendering a bundle with the renderer installed for ``python``."""     python = Path(python)     package = next(python.parent.parent.glob("lib/python3*/site-packages/*_enrichers")).name     code = (f"import json,sys; from {package}.standalone import render_markdown_report as r;"             "sys.stdout.write(r(json.load(sys.stdin)))")     def render(bundle):         return subprocess.run([str(python), "-c", code], input=json.dumps(bundle),                               capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout     return render

symbols.name: run_cli
symbols.content: def run_cli(run, entry, name, arguments, cancel_after_connect=False):     """Run the packaged entrypoint with a minimal environment and an audit hook."""     hook = run.work / "hook"     hook.mkdir(exist_ok=True)     (hook / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(SITECUSTOMIZE, encoding="utf-8")     audit = run.work / f"{name}.audit.jsonl"     output = run.work / name     env = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(run.work), "PYTHONPATH": str(hook),            "RELEASE_SMOKE_AUDIT_LOG": str(audit)}     started = time.monotonic()     out_log, err_log = run.work / f"{name}.stdout", run.work / f"{name}.stderr"     with open(out_log, "w") as stdout_file, open(err_log, "w") as stderr_file:         proc = subprocess.Popen([str(entry), *arguments, "--output-dir", str(output)], env=env,                                 stdout=stdout_file, stderr=stderr_file)         if cancel_after_connect:             deadline = time.monotonic() + 20             # waitid(WNOWAIT) observes exit without reaping, so wait4 below still owns the child.             while time.monotonic() < deadline and os.waitid(                 os.P_PID, proc.pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT             ) is None:                 if audit.exists() and '"socket.connect"' in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):                     time.sleep(0.1)                     proc.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)                     break                 time.sleep(0.02)         # wait4 gives this process' own rusage (RUSAGE_CHILDREN would mix in the build).         _, wait_status, usage = os.wait4(proc.pid, 0)         proc.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(wait_status)     stdout, stderr = out_log.read_text(), err_log.read_text()     events = [json.loads(line) for line in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()] if audit.exists() else []     run.measurements[name] = {         "wall_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),         "user_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_utime, 3),         "system_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_stime, 3),         "peak_rss_kib": next((e["kib"] for e in events if e["event"] == "peak_rss"), None),         "output_bytes": sum(p.stat().st_size for p in output.rglob("*") if p.is_file()) if output.exists() else 0,     }     return proc.returncode, stdout, stderr, output, events

symbols.name: audit_problems
symbols.content: def audit_problems(events, port):     problems = []     for event in events:         if event["event"] == "socket.connect":             address = event["address"]             if not (isinstance(address, list) and address[:2] == ["127.0.0.1", port]):                 problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: connection to {address} (only the loopback fixture is allowed)")         elif event["event"] == "import" and event["module"] in FORBIDDEN_MODULES:             problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: imported service/model module {event['module']}")     if not any(event["event"] == "import" for event in events):         problems.append("E_SERVICE: audit hook recorded nothing; isolation is unproven")     return problems

symbols.name: negative_controls
symbols.content: def negative_controls(run, sample):     """The verifier must reject a broken copy of a good bundle (proves it is not vacuous)."""     results = {}     for name in ("broken-lineage", "missing-source-proof", "missing-source-body"):         copy = run.work / f"negative-{name}"         shutil.copytree(sample, copy)         bundle = json.loads((copy / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))         target = next(o for o in bundle["outcomes"] if o["status"] == "success" and o["links"])         if name == "broken-lineage":             for item in target["links"] + target["observations"]:                 item["occurrence_id"] = "input-999"         elif name == "missing-source-proof":             target["source_reference"] = None         if name != "missing-source-body":             (copy / "bundle.json").write_text(json.dumps(bundle, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")             with open(copy / "outcomes.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:                 for outcome in bundle["outcomes"]:                     handle.write(json.dumps({"schema_version": bundle["schema_version"],                                              "operation_id": bundle["operation_id"], "outcome": outcome},                                             sort_keys=True) + "\n")         else:             digest = target["source_reference"]["artifact"]["content_digest"]             (copy / "source-artifacts/objects" / digest[:2] / f"{digest}.body").unlink()         results[name] = verify_bundle(copy)     return results

symbols.name: case
symbols.content: def case(self, ident, title, problems, **detail):         status = "PASS" if not problems else "FAIL"         self.cases.append({"id": ident, "title": title, "status": status, "problems": problems, **detail})         print(f"{status} {ident} {title}")         for problem in problems:             print(f"  {problem}")

symbols.name: sha256
symbols.content: def sha256(data):     return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

symbols.name: _decode_proof
symbols.content: def _decode_proof(token):     try:         prefix, body = token.split(".", 1)[0], token.split(".")[1]         if prefix != "sp1":             return None         return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(body + "=" * (-len(body) % 4)))     except (ValueError, IndexError, binascii.Error, json.JSONDecodeError):         return None

symbols.name: check_expectations
symbols.content: def check_expectations(output_dir, manifest, base_url):     """Compare the batch bundle with the fixture corpus' retained bytes and labels."""     bundle = json.loads((Path(output_dir) / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     sources = {s["id"]: s for s in manifest["sources"]}     problems = []     outcomes = {o["key"]: o for o in bundle["outcomes"]}     if list(outcomes) != list(BATCH):         problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: keys {list(outcomes)} != submitted {list(BATCH)}")     for key, (source_id, status, code) in BATCH.items():         outcome = outcomes.get(key)         if outcome is None:             continue         source = sources[source_id]         if outcome["requested_url"] != base_url + source["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} requested {outcome['requested_url']}")         if outcome["status"] != status or (outcome["diagnostic"] or {}).get("code") != code:             problems.append(f"E_OUTCOME: {key} is {outcome['status']}/{outcome['diagnostic']}, expected {status}/{code}")         if status != "success" or outcome["source_reference"] is None:             continue         final = sources[source["response"]["location"].strip("/")] if "location" in source["response"] else source         artifact = outcome["source_reference"]["artifact"]         if artifact["content_digest"] != final["sha256"]:             problems.append(f"E_SOURCE_DIGEST: {key} retained bytes differ from fixture {final['id']}")         if artifact["final_url"] != base_url + final["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} final_url {artifact['final_url']}")     empty, failure = outcomes.get("empty"), outcomes.get("failure")     if empty and (empty["text"] or empty["diagnostic"] is not None or empty["source_reference"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: legitimate empty page is not an empty success with source proof")     if failure and (failure["source_reference"] is not None or failure["diagnostic"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: HTTP failure is not an explicit error")     first, again = outcomes.get("static"), outcomes.get("static-again")     if first and again and first["source_reference"] and again["source_reference"]:         if first["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"] == again["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"]:             problems.append("E_LINEAGE: duplicate URL occurrences share one snapshot")     return problems

symbols.content: def _load_fixtures():     spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("acquisition_fixtures", REPO / "scripts/acquisition_fixtures.py")     module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)     spec.loader.exec_module(module)     return module

symbols.name: _sh
symbols.content: def _sh(command, **kwargs):     proc = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, **kwargs)     if proc.returncode != 0:         raise RuntimeError(f"{' '.join(map(str, command))} failed ({proc.returncode}): {proc.stderr[-2000:]}")     return proc.stdout

symbols.name: build_and_install
symbols.content: def build_and_install(run, revision):     """Package the committed tree (not the working tree) and install it in a fresh venv."""     source = run.work / "source"     wheels = run.work / "wheels"     venv = run.work / "venv"     wheels.mkdir(parents=True)     source.mkdir()     tree = _sh(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", f"{revision}^{{tree}}"]).strip()     archive = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "archive", "--format=tar", revision],                              capture_output=True, check=True).stdout     subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(source)], input=archive, check=True)     started = time.monotonic()     for package in PACKAGES:         _sh(["uv", "build", "--wheel", "-q", "-o", str(wheels), str(next(source.glob(f"*-{package}")))])     requirements = run.work / "requirements.txt"     enrichers = next(source.glob("*-enrichers")).name     _sh(["uv", "export", "--frozen", "--no-hashes", "--no-emit-workspace", "--no-dev",          "--package", enrichers, "-q", "-o", str(requirements)], cwd=source)     _sh(["uv", "venv", "-q", "--python", sys.executable if sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12) else "3.12", str(venv)])     _sh(["uv", "pip", "install", "-q", "--python", str(venv / "bin/python"), "--find-links", str(wheels),          "-r", str(requirements), *map(str, sorted(wheels.glob("*.whl")))])     entry = next((venv / "bin").glob("*-standalone-scraper"))     run.measurements["build_install_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)     return {         "revision": _sh(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", revision]).strip(),         "source_tree": tree,         "wheels": {w.name: sha256(w.read_bytes()) for w in sorted(wheels.glob("*.whl"))},         "lock_export_sha256": sha256(requirements.read_bytes()),         "uv_lock_sha256": sha256((source / "uv.lock").read_bytes()),         "entrypoint": entry.name,         "python": _sh([str(venv / "bin/python"), "--version"]).strip(),     }, venv, entry

symbols.name: _render_with
symbols.content: def _render_with(python):     """Return a callable rendering a bundle with the renderer installed for ``python``."""     python = Path(python)     package = next(python.parent.parent.glob("lib/python3*/site-packages/*_enrichers")).name     code = (f"import json,sys; from {package}.standalone import render_markdown_report as r;"             "sys.stdout.write(r(json.load(sys.stdin)))")     def render(bundle):         return subprocess.run([str(python), "-c", code], input=json.dumps(bundle),                               capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout     return render

symbols.name: run_cli
symbols.content: def run_cli(run, entry, name, arguments, cancel_after_connect=False):     """Run the packaged entrypoint with a minimal environment and an audit hook."""     hook = run.work / "hook"     hook.mkdir(exist_ok=True)     (hook / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(SITECUSTOMIZE, encoding="utf-8")     audit = run.work / f"{name}.audit.jsonl"     output = run.work / name     env = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(run.work), "PYTHONPATH": str(hook),            "RELEASE_SMOKE_AUDIT_LOG": str(audit)}     started = time.monotonic()     out_log, err_log = run.work / f"{name}.stdout", run.work / f"{name}.stderr"     with open(out_log, "w") as stdout_file, open(err_log, "w") as stderr_file:         proc = subprocess.Popen([str(entry), *arguments, "--output-dir", str(output)], env=env,                                 stdout=stdout_file, stderr=stderr_file)         if cancel_after_connect:             deadline = time.monotonic() + 20             # waitid(WNOWAIT) observes exit without reaping, so wait4 below still owns the child.             while time.monotonic() < deadline and os.waitid(                 os.P_PID, proc.pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT             ) is None:                 if audit.exists() and '"socket.connect"' in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):                     time.sleep(0.1)                     proc.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)                     break                 time.sleep(0.02)         # wait4 gives this process' own rusage (RUSAGE_CHILDREN would mix in the build).         _, wait_status, usage = os.wait4(proc.pid, 0)         proc.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(wait_status)     stdout, stderr = out_log.read_text(), err_log.read_text()     events = [json.loads(line) for line in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()] if audit.exists() else []     run.measurements[name] = {         "wall_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),         "user_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_utime, 3),         "system_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_stime, 3),         "peak_rss_kib": next((e["kib"] for e in events if e["event"] == "peak_rss"), None),         "output_bytes": sum(p.stat().st_size for p in output.rglob("*") if p.is_file()) if output.exists() else 0,     }     return proc.returncode, stdout, stderr, output, events

symbols.name: audit_problems
symbols.content: def audit_problems(events, port):     problems = []     for event in events:         if event["event"] == "socket.connect":             address = event["address"]             if not (isinstance(address, list) and address[:2] == ["127.0.0.1", port]):                 problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: connection to {address} (only the loopback fixture is allowed)")         elif event["event"] == "import" and event["module"] in FORBIDDEN_MODULES:             problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: imported service/model module {event['module']}")     if not any(event["event"] == "import" for event in events):         problems.append("E_SERVICE: audit hook recorded nothing; isolation is unproven")     return problems

symbols.name: negative_controls
symbols.content: def negative_controls(run, sample):     """The verifier must reject a broken copy of a good bundle (proves it is not vacuous)."""     results = {}     for name in ("broken-lineage", "missing-source-proof", "missing-source-body"):         copy = run.work / f"negative-{name}"         shutil.copytree(sample, copy)         bundle = json.loads((copy / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))         target = next(o for o in bundle["outcomes"] if o["status"] == "success" and o["links"])         if name == "broken-lineage":             for item in target["links"] + target["observations"]:                 item["occurrence_id"] = "input-999"         elif name == "missing-source-proof":             target["source_reference"] = None         if name != "missing-source-body":             (copy / "bundle.json").write_text(json.dumps(bundle, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")             with open(copy / "outcomes.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:                 for outcome in bundle["outcomes"]:                     handle.write(json.dumps({"schema_version": bundle["schema_version"],                                              "operation_id": bundle["operation_id"], "outcome": outcome},                                             sort_keys=True) + "\n")         else:             digest = target["source_reference"]["artifact"]["content_digest"]             (copy / "source-artifacts/objects" / digest[:2] / f"{digest}.body").unlink()         results[name] = verify_bundle(copy)     return results

symbols.name: case
symbols.content: def case(self, ident, title, problems, **detail):         status = "PASS" if not problems else "FAIL"         self.cases.append({"id": ident, "title": title, "status": status, "problems": problems, **detail})         print(f"{status} {ident} {title}")         for problem in problems:             print(f"  {problem}")

artifact["content_digest"] != final["sha256"]:             problems.append(f"E_SOURCE_DIGEST: {key} retained bytes differ from fixture {final['id']}")         if artifact["final_url"] != base_url + final["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} final_url {artifact['final_url']}")     empty, failure = outcomes.get("empty"), outcomes.get("failure")     if empty and (empty["text"] or empty["diagnostic"] is not None or empty["source_reference"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: legitimate empty page is not an empty success with source proof")     if failure and (failure["source_reference"] is not None or failure["diagnostic"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: HTTP failure is not an explicit error")     first, again = outcomes.get("static"), outcomes.get("static-again")     if first and again and first["source_reference"] and again["source_reference"]:         if first["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"] == again["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"]:             problems.append("E_LINEAGE: duplicate URL occurrences share one snapshot")     return problems

symbols.name: build_and_install
symbols.content: def build_and_install(run, revision):     """Package the committed tree (not the working tree) and install it in a fresh venv."""     source = run.work / "source"     wheels = run.work / "wheels"     venv = run.work / "venv"     wheels.mkdir(parents=True)     source.mkdir()     tree = _sh(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", f"{revision}^{{tree}}"]).strip()     archive = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "archive", "--format=tar", revision],                              capture_output=True, check=True).stdout     subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(source)], input=archive, check=True)     started = time.monotonic()     for package in PACKAGES:         _sh(["uv", "build", "--wheel", "-q", "-o", str(wheels), str(next(source.glob(f"*-{package}")))])     requirements = run.work / "requirements.txt"     enrichers = next(source.glob("*-enrichers")).name     _sh(["uv", "export", "--frozen", "--no-hashes", "--no-emit-workspace", "--no-dev",          "--package", enrichers, "-q", "-o", str(requirements)], cwd=source)     _sh(["uv", "venv", "-q", "--python", sys.executable if sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12) else "3.12", str(venv)])     _sh(["uv", "pip", "install", "-q", "--python", str(venv / "bin/python"), "--find-links", str(wheels),          "-r", str(requirements), *map(str, sorted(wheels.glob("*.whl")))])     entry = next((venv / "bin").glob("*-standalone-scraper"))     run.measurements["build_install_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)     return {         "revision": _sh(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", revision]).strip(),         "source_tree": tree,         "wheels": {w.name: sha256(w.read_bytes()) for w in sorted(wheels.glob("*.whl"))},         "lock_export_sha256": sha256(requirements.read_bytes()),         "uv_lock_sha256": sha256((source / "uv.lock").read_bytes()),         "entrypoint": entry.name,         "python": _sh([str(venv / "bin/python"), "--version"]).strip(),     }, venv, entry

symbols.name: _render_with
symbols.content: def _render_with(python):     """Return a callable rendering a bundle with the renderer installed for ``python``."""     python = Path(python)     package = next(python.parent.parent.glob("lib/python3*/site-packages/*_enrichers")).name     code = (f"import json,sys; from {package}.standalone import render_markdown_report as r;"             "sys.stdout.write(r(json.load(sys.stdin)))")     def render(bundle):         return subprocess.run([str(python), "-c", code], input=json.dumps(bundle),                               capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout     return render

symbols.name: run_cli
symbols.content: def run_cli(run, entry, name, arguments, cancel_after_connect=False):     """Run the packaged entrypoint with a minimal environment and an audit hook."""     hook = run.work / "hook"     hook.mkdir(exist_ok=True)     (hook / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(SITECUSTOMIZE, encoding="utf-8")     audit = run.work / f"{name}.audit.jsonl"     output = run.work / name     env = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(run.work), "PYTHONPATH": str(hook),            "RELEASE_SMOKE_AUDIT_LOG": str(audit)}     started = time.monotonic()     out_log, err_log = run.work / f"{name}.stdout", run.work / f"{name}.stderr"     with open(out_log, "w") as stdout_file, open(err_log, "w") as stderr_file:         proc = subprocess.Popen([str(entry), *arguments, "--output-dir", str(output)], env=env,                                 stdout=stdout_file, stderr=stderr_file)         if cancel_after_connect:             deadline = time.monotonic() + 20             # waitid(WNOWAIT) observes exit without reaping, so wait4 below still owns the child.             while time.monotonic() < deadline and os.waitid(                 os.P_PID, proc.pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT             ) is None:                 if audit.exists() and '"socket.connect"' in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):                     time.sleep(0.1)                     proc.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)                     break                 time.sleep(0.02)         # wait4 gives this process' own rusage (RUSAGE_CHILDREN would mix in the build).         _, wait_status, usage = os.wait4(proc.pid, 0)         proc.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(wait_status)     stdout, stderr = out_log.read_text(), err_log.read_text()     events = [json.loads(line) for line in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()] if audit.exists() else []     run.measurements[name] = {         "wall_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),         "user_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_utime, 3),         "system_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_stime, 3),         "peak_rss_kib": next((e["kib"] for e in events if e["event"] == "peak_rss"), None),         "output_bytes": sum(p.stat().st_size for p in output.rglob("*") if p.is_file()) if output.exists() else 0,     }     return proc.returncode, stdout, stderr, output, events

symbols.name: audit_problems
symbols.content: def audit_problems(events, port):     problems = []     for event in events:         if event["event"] == "socket.connect":             address = event["address"]             if not (isinstance(address, list) and address[:2] == ["127.0.0.1", port]):                 problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: connection to {address} (only the loopback fixture is allowed)")         elif event["event"] == "import" and event["module"] in FORBIDDEN_MODULES:             problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: imported service/model module {event['module']}")     if not any(event["event"] == "import" for event in events):         problems.append("E_SERVICE: audit hook recorded nothing; isolation is unproven")     return problems

symbols.name: negative_controls
symbols.content: def negative_controls(run, sample):     """The verifier must reject a broken copy of a good bundle (proves it is not vacuous)."""     results = {}     for name in ("broken-lineage", "missing-source-proof", "missing-source-body"):         copy = run.work / f"negative-{name}"         shutil.copytree(sample, copy)         bundle = json.loads((copy / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))         target = next(o for o in bundle["outcomes"] if o["status"] == "success" and o["links"])         if name == "broken-lineage":             for item in target["links"] + target["observations"]:                 item["occurrence_id"] = "input-999"         elif name == "missing-source-proof":             target["source_reference"] = None         if name != "missing-source-body":             (copy / "bundle.json").write_text(json.dumps(bundle, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")             with open(copy / "outcomes.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:                 for outcome in bundle["outcomes"]:                     handle.write(json.dumps({"schema_version": bundle["schema_version"],                                              "operation_id": bundle["operation_id"], "outcome": outcome},                                             sort_keys=True) + "\n")         else:             digest = target["source_reference"]["artifact"]["content_digest"]             (copy / "source-artifacts/objects" / digest[:2] / f"{digest}.body").unlink()         results[name] = verify_bundle(copy)     return results

symbols.content: def case(self, ident, title, problems, **detail):         status = "PASS" if not problems else "FAIL"         self.cases.append({"id": ident, "title": title, "status": status, "problems": problems, **detail})         print(f"{status} {ident} {title}")         for problem in problems:             print(f"  {problem}")

symbols.name: sha256
symbols.content: def sha256(data):     return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

symbols.name: _decode_proof
symbols.content: def _decode_proof(token):     try:         prefix, body = token.split(".", 1)[0], token.split(".")[1]         if prefix != "sp1":             return None         return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(body + "=" * (-len(body) % 4)))     except (ValueError, IndexError, binascii.Error, json.JSONDecodeError):         return None

symbols.name: _sh
symbols.content: def _sh(command, **kwargs):     proc = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, **kwargs)     if proc.returncode != 0:         raise RuntimeError(f"{' '.join(map(str, command))} failed ({proc.returncode}): {proc.stderr[-2000:]}")     return proc.stdout
